description: Adversarial Claims Court and Blind Mathematical Re-Derivation

evaluations.claim: SFace achieves 98.15% TAR at FAR=1e-3 on LFW
evaluations.objection_1: LFW consists of celebrities under web-scraped conditions, not Indian gig workers.
evaluations.objection_2: LFW protocol does not reflect 1:N deduplication scale.
evaluations.objection_3: Lighting conditions on LFW do not test harsh Karnataka outdoor glare.
evaluations.response: Acknowledged; LFW serves exclusively as algorithmic parity benchmark. Strict 40% cap enforced until in-domain cohort collected.

evaluations.claim: Keyed orthogonal rotation provides ISO/IEC 24745 irreversibility
evaluations.objection_1: Orthogonal rotation is a linear isometry that preserves distances exactly.
evaluations.objection_2: Known-Plaintext Attack (Procrustes) recovers rotation matrix at k=128.
evaluations.objection_3: Pairwise Gram matrices permit cross-tenant identity linkage.
evaluations.response: Objections upheld. Attack T-02 and T-03 confirmed complete cryptographic vulnerability. Claim formally restated.

evaluations.claim: 1:N deduplication can automatically reject duplicate applicants
evaluations.objection_1: At G=100,000 and FMR=1e-5, FPIR is 63.2% (1 false match per probe).
evaluations.objection_2: Automated rejection would disenfranchise innocent workers.
evaluations.objection_3: DPDPA principles mandate contestability and human review.
evaluations.response: Objections upheld. Deduplication policy strictly updated: duplicate hits NEVER auto-reject; route to human review.
